scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @pm-tool/server" "npm run dev -w @pm-tool/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
